capabilities: Synchronize a vault two-way with a self-hosted WebObsidian server over Central Sync Protocol 1.0
Pair a device using a one-use, 10-minute pairing code
Merge independent UTF-8 text edits three-way and keep overlapping changes as conflict copies
Resolve conflicts by comparing base, server, and client text or retaining both copies
Pause, resume, and inspect sync status and unresolved-conflict counts from commands and the status bar
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; 0.1.22 is a community review release not yet listed in the Community Plugins directory, and a SECURITY.md covers threat-model details. Mobile background sync is not guaranteed while the OS suspends the app.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid service and generic file sync can silently overwrite stale revisions or lose conflicting edits, so self-hosters need a revision-safe alternative.

relations.evidence: two-way synchronization between an Obsidian vault and a self-hosted WebObsidian server

requires.name: WebObsidian server with Central Sync Protocol 1.0

summary: Two-way vault sync client for a self-hosted WebObsidian server, with revision tracking, three-way text merge, and conflict copies.
